originalDemoCandidates.comment:
Demo: https://www.doomworld.com/applications/core/interface/file/attachment.php?id=109802

I enjoyed this map a lot more than I thought I would when I was initially playing through it. The layout seems winding and confusing, but with a good route it flows surprisingly well, with little backtracking or dead air. The level's pretty easy since it's generous with resources and never unleashes too many enemies at once, but it was fun to try to push the time down. The par time for this level is 7:00, so I'm glad I was able to get under that.
